Betting and Gaming Levy (Amendment) 1
Act, No. 25 of 2025
[Certified on 17th of December, 2025]
L.D.-O 13/2025
An Act to Amend the Betting And gAming Levy
Act, no. 40 of 1988
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1. This Act may be cited as the Betting and Gaming Levy Short title
(Amendment) Act, No. 25 of 2025.
2. Section 2 of the Betting and Gaming Levy Act, No. 40 Amendment of
of 1988, as last amended by Act, No. 11 of 2023 is hereby section 2 of Act,
No. 40 of 1988
further amended as follows: -
(1) in subsection (1A) of that section -
(a) in paragraph (b) of that subsection by the
substitution for the words, “ten per centum;
or” of the words, “ten per centum;”;
(b) in paragraph (c) of that subsection by the
substitution for the words and figures, “for
any year commencing on or after April 1,
2023, at the rate of fifteen per centum,” of the
words and figures, “for any year commencing
on or after April 1, 2023 but ending prior
to January 1, 2026 at the rate of fifteen
per centum; or”; and
(c) by the insertion immediately after paragraph
(c) of that subsection of the following new
paragraph: -

(2) in paragraph (b) of subsection (1AA) of that
section by the substitution for the words, “United
States Dollars fifty” of the words, “United States
